nodes.description: Public boolean in OHMCirculatingSupplyConrtact guarding one-time initialization.
Address of the OHM ERC20 token whose supply is queried by the contract.
Privileged owner address controlling initialize, address-list updates and ownership transfer.
Public array of addresses whose OHM balances are excluded from circulating supply.
Constructor(address _owner) that sets the initial owner.
initialize(address _ohm) external; owner-only, one-time setter of the OHM token address.
OHMCirculatingSupply() external view returning total supply minus non-circulating OHM.
getNonCirculatingOHM() public view summing OHM balances of the non-circulating address list.
setNonCirculatingOHMAddresses(address[]) external owner-only setter of the exclusion list.
transferOwnership(address) external owner-only ownership transfer.
SafeMath.add(uint256,uint256) overflow-checked addition.
SafeMath.sub(uint256,uint256) underflow-checked subtraction.
SafeMath.mul(uint256,uint256) overflow-checked multiplication.
SafeMath.div(uint256,uint256) division with zero-check.
SafeMath.mod(uint256,uint256) modulo with zero-check.
SafeMath.sqrrt(uint256) Babylonian square root helper.
SafeMath.percentageAmount(uint256,uint8) percentage helper.
SafeMath.substractPercentage(uint256,uint8) percentage subtraction helper.
SafeMath.percentageOfTotal(uint256,uint256) ratio helper.
SafeMath.average(uint256,uint256) overflow-aware average.
SafeMath.quadraticPricing(uint256,uint256) square-root pricing helper.
SafeMath.bondingCurve(uint256,uint256) linear bonding curve helper.
msg.sender used as the caller identity check inside initialize().
msg.sender used as the caller identity check inside setNonCirculatingOHMAddresses().
msg.sender used as the caller identity check inside transferOwnership().
require(msg.sender == owner, "caller is not owner") access-control gate in initialize().
require(isInitialized == false) re-initialization guard in initialize().
require(msg.sender == owner, "Sender is not owner") access-control gate in setNonCirculatingOHMAddresses().
require(msg.sender == owner, "Sender is not owner") access-control gate in transferOwnership().
External call IERC20(OHM).totalSupply() to an attacker-influenceable token address.
Repeated external calls IERC20(OHM).balanceOf(...) inside the getNonCirculatingOHM loop.
SafeMath.sub of total supply minus non-circulating OHM; can revert on arithmetic condition.
SafeMath.add accumulation of token balances in getNonCirculatingOHM.
Constructor parameter _owner.
initialize() calldata parameter _ohm.
setNonCirculatingOHMAddresses() calldata array parameter.
transferOwnership() parameter _owner.
Local _totalSupply holding IERC20(OHM).totalSupply().
Local _circulatingSupply holding the computed circulating supply.
Local _nonCirculatingOHM accumulator in getNonCirculatingOHM.
Loop counter i over nonCirculatingOHMAddresses.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter _owner flows into the constructor body.
Constructor writes the initial value of the owner state variable.
initialize() parameter _ohm is the value assigned to state.
initialize() executes the require(msg.sender == owner) access-control check.
Untrusted msg.sender is compared against owner in the require statement.
owner state variable is read as the expected caller in the require check.
initialize() executes the isInitialized == false guard.
isInitialized state variable is read by the re-initialization guard.
initialize() writes the OHM token address state variable.
initialize() sets isInitialized to true.
OHMCirculatingSupply() performs the external IERC20(OHM).totalSupply() call.
OHM state address is used as the target of the external totalSupply() call.
External totalSupply() result is stored in local _totalSupply.
OHMCirculatingSupply() calls getNonCirculatingOHM() internally.
OHMCirculatingSupply() executes the SafeMath subtraction.
Local _totalSupply is the minuend of the circulating-supply subtraction.
Subtraction result is stored in local _circulatingSupply.
getNonCirculatingOHM() performs external balanceOf() calls in its loop.
OHM state address targets the external balanceOf() calls.
nonCirculatingOHMAddresses state array supplies the accounts queried by balanceOf().
Loop index i selects the array element passed to balanceOf().
Each balanceOf() result is accumulated by the SafeMath addition.
getNonCirculatingOHM() executes the SafeMath accumulation addition.
Accumulated sum is stored in local _nonCirculatingOHM.
getNonCirculatingOHM() loop increment uses SafeMath.add for i.
Loop index i is the first operand of the SafeMath.add increment.
SafeMath.add result is written back to the loop index i.
setNonCirculatingOHMAddresses() executes its owner require check.
Untrusted msg.sender is compared against owner in the require statement.
owner state variable is read as the expected caller in the require check.
Calldata array parameter flows into setNonCirculatingOHMAddresses().
setNonCirculatingOHMAddresses() overwrites the nonCirculatingOHMAddresses state array.
transferOwnership() executes its owner require check.
Untrusted msg.sender is compared against owner in the require statement.
owner state variable is read as the expected caller in the require check.
Parameter _owner flows into transferOwnership().
transferOwnership() writes the new owner state variable.
sqrrt() calls SafeMath.add during its Babylonian iteration.
sqrrt() calls SafeMath.div during its Babylonian iteration.
percentageAmount() calls SafeMath.mul.
percentageAmount() calls SafeMath.div.
substractPercentage() calls SafeMath.sub.
substractPercentage() calls SafeMath.mul.
substractPercentage() calls SafeMath.div.
percentageOfTotal() calls SafeMath.mul.
percentageOfTotal() calls SafeMath.div.
quadraticPricing() calls SafeMath.sqrrt.
quadraticPricing() calls SafeMath.mul.
bondingCurve() calls SafeMath.mul.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter _owner is only used to seed the owner state variable, so it is merged into the constructor core node.
Parameter _ohm is consumed solely by initialize() when assigning the OHM state variable.
Calldata array parameter is assigned directly to the nonCirculatingOHMAddresses state array inside the setter.
Parameter _owner is only written to the owner state variable inside transferOwnership().
Local temporary _totalSupply exists only to hold the external totalSupply() result inside OHMCirculatingSupply().
Local temporary _circulatingSupply exists only to hold and return the subtraction result of OHMCirculatingSupply().
Local accumulator _nonCirculatingOHM exists only inside getNonCirculatingOHM() to sum excluded balances.
Loop counter i exists only to iterate over the exclusion list inside getNonCirculatingOHM().
